title: Miller the trumpeter and the band's changing sidemen
summary: Thomas describes a good trumpeter Miller who drank and missed jobs, lists other sidemen, and says Steve Angrum was his last clarinet player.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That was hard one too. That was hard one. Yeah. So Millie man, Millie. I tell you about Millie. Millie was a nice trumpet. That was a trumpet. That was a trumpet. Miller was a nice trouble man, he was a really nice trouble. Man, he was kind and everything, but the only thing we had trouble with Miller, man, you see that you hired Miller to play a job, man, he, nah alright, you don't told him he was going to play, said he was going to play tonight. You know what Miller do? He said, Miller be coming to the job and he meet somebody, go to the drink, he go to the bar and he forgot about the job, man, he ain't going to shut up. That's the only trouble with Miller, but he was a darn good kind of play, you know what I mean? Yeah. That's right. But that's what he was on and for. Like to drink. Like to drink. You see if you meet somebody and you're on and we're on the job, that's it. You need to look for Miller. So he never was regular with your band? Well no, he played like off and on like that you know. I had different fellas, man, Handy played with me a fella. I had Edmund Washington, and I had a fella called Henry Harden. He played tenor. We had two alto and tenor, you see, in the band, you know what I mean? We used to travel all over then, you know what I mean? Well Steve Angrum, was that the last clarinet player you used? You seem to be a used monthly saxophone player of all the way. Who was the last clarinet player that worked with you? He was the last clarinet player. Because I used Edmund Warden.

You see Edmund Warden, he used to play clarinet too. You know, he quit playing clarinet and took up the saxophone. But he had to start back on the clarinet again. Yeah, Steve was the last clarinet player. I don't know. The last one. Why do you prefer saxophone in your band? I mean why do you? Well I tell you.
